question: Does a cap on knots per distinction (or per pair) stop the cheapest growth at two orders with the two orders still growing; which state differences separate matched starts with the same states and different knots, and do they persist; what do the states remember after the knots are erased?

definitions.cap: after a move every distinction lies in at most c knots; pair cap: every pair in at most m knots
definitions.distance: total variation between two starts' distributions over full classes, classes of states, or coarse features
definitions.erasure: KF3 to n = 8, then the states-only fewest-states rule of STATE-RULES (three knots, extensions counted one by one)

public_inputs.code: caplib.py (sha256 d6402f8b762a629672529817b553de85af32c75bfbfc3ad377b08bb18a11c8a2), run.py (sha256 466efc57278e9ac3ba5c6a76b51e0d1dcee33a22f8506b4486891c13de51a6b7), checks.py (sha256 1e6bce06e28511293a760265653db2bb299b3e5caa75dcb25180d0c31a79287a); experiments/STATE-RULES-20261117-001B/STATE-RULES-20261117-001B-E001_rules/rules.py (sha256 d1ee374ca2c6784bdbad72c32878d7c6a3c98c60a28da73f34f14f76c8d10172); networkx 3.6.1 in the workspace .venv
public_inputs.run: .venv/bin/python -B run.py --part NAME for K1-K5, each its own process, then run.py --merge

forbidden_inputs: Changing rules, starts, readings, predictions or decision rules after seeing registered results
cheapest_meaningful_control: c = 3 and the pair cap from one knot (proved stops); the sampling floor (same start, other seeds); the no-erasure control.

predictions.C1: c3 and pair2: square at 4, then stall, probability 1
predictions.C2: c4: no stall at 5; at 16 <= 3 fills, no cube, lambda = 2 majority
predictions.C3: c5 no Q3 at 8; c6 Q3 at 8 < half, no Q4; c9 Q3 at 8 majority, Q4 at 16 minority; c12 Q3 at 8 majority
predictions.C4: no rule: lambda = 2 with >= 4 fills at 16 in a majority
predictions.C5: six-starts: equal two-order probability at 8; states TV 3/4 at 7, >= 0.7 to 10; features TV <= 0.03
predictions.C6: five-starts: TV 0 at 5, >= 0.5 at 6, >= 0.6 to 10; two-order probabilities equal
predictions.C7: sampled TV at 7, 8 above floors, p < 0.01; two-order counts at 8 within 3 SE
predictions.C9: c5, c6 from six-starts: stalls < 5% by 12

decision_rules.each prediction: holds or fails as stated in the pre-registration

stop_rule: One run; A97 and A99 status; referee hand-off; report.
runtime: Parts in parallel; expected under an hour; registered in docs/LONG_RUNNING.md if a part passes ten minutes.
